checked.item: Close (✕) icon button: named "Close" via aria-label, reachable by Tab, native focus ring
Run reconciliation button: reachable, solid 2px focus outline; on an empty form focus moves to Integration and role=alert says "Select an integration"
Run reconciliation with uploads missing: where focus goes and what is announced
Date range tooltip (?) button: named "About date range", bubble shows on focus, focus shown only by a border and text colour change, no aria-describedby
Date range select: label "Date range *" linked, keyboard-operable
Custom start/end date inputs: named "Start date" / "End date" through aria-label
Integration select: label linked, ArrowDown picks Stripe and focus stays
Account select: label linked, disabled until an integration is picked; the "Select an integration first" hint is not tied to it by aria-describedby
Invalid state after a blocked Run: field-invalid is a class only, with no aria-invalid and no aria-describedby to the error
Set import methods / Use automatic retrieval toggle: a real button, focus stays on it after Enter, its name changes with the state
Import method selects (Accounting and Integration sides): accessible name
How-to accordion headers: real buttons, aria-expanded toggles; focus after Enter
Browse buttons (x2): names and focus after Enter
Remove (file chip) button: focus after Enter
Matching rules links (x2, a href=#): both named "Matching rules" with no side context
role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby present; focus on open, Tab containment, Escape and focus return
Tab order follows reading order: Close, Run, Period, Integration, Account, toggle, Accounting method, Matching rules, Integration method, accordion, Browse, ... Matching rules, then body
Focus visibility on selects: border unchanged, only a 3px rgba(0,83,204,0.12) box-shadow ring (low confidence without pixel check, not reported)

findings.element: Matching rules modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true), opened from either "Matching rules" link
findings.finding: Opening the dialog leaves focus on the trigger link, Tab moves into background controls behind the modal, and Escape does not send focus back to the trigger.
findings.user_impact: A keyboard or screen-reader user isn't taken into the dialog, can work controls hidden behind the backdrop while it is open, and after Escape lands somewhere that is not the link they came from.
findings.suggested_fix: When the dialog opens, move focus to its heading or Close button and keep Tab and Shift+Tab inside it; on Escape or Close, send focus back to the link that opened it.

evidence.action: Manual panel: focus the first "Matching rules" link, press Enter, press Tab x3, then Escape
evidence.observed: Focus on open stayed on A.lnk.match-open "Matching rules"; Tab went to SELECT[data-side=integration], then BUTTON.acc-h "How to get Balance change...", then BUTTON.db "Browse" (all behind the modal); after Escape the modal closed with focus on BUTTON.db "Browse". The state map, using the auto-card link, recorded Tab → Close → body and Escape → body.

findings.element: "Import method *" selects on the Accounting side (data-side=books) and the Integration side (data-side=integration)
findings.finding: Neither select has an accessible name: the visible "Import method *" is a <label> with no for or wrapping, so it isn't linked, and the two selects can't be told apart.
findings.user_impact: A screen-reader user hears two nameless combo boxes, "Automated (recommended)" and "Assisted", and must guess which one sets QuickBooks and which one sets Stripe, even though this choice decides which files are required.
findings.suggested_fix: Give each select an id and a matching <label for>, with a side-specific name such as "QuickBooks import method" and "Stripe import method" (or aria-labelledby that includes the side heading).

evidence.action: Stripe + clearing, press Enter on "Set import methods", then Tab to each method select
evidence.observed: Focus reached SELECT[data-side=books] and SELECT[data-side=integration]; for both, labels[] was empty and there was no aria-label or aria-labelledby. The parent is <div class=msel><label class=msel-lab>Import method *</label><select ...>. The state map records accessible_name_present=false for both.

findings.element: How-to accordion headers, Browse buttons and Remove buttons in "How we get the data"
findings.finding: Pressing Enter on any of these re-renders the panel and drops focus to <body>, so the keyboard user loses their place.
findings.user_impact: After each upload, removal or expanded instruction, a keyboard or screen-reader user gets no announcement of the result, has to find their way back, and the next Tab restarts at the top of the sources panel.
findings.suggested_fix: After a re-render, put focus back on the same control (matched by its data-steps or data-rm key), or on the new file chip's Remove button after Browse, and on the Browse button after Remove.

evidence.action: Manual panel: Enter on BUTTON.acc-h; Enter on the first BUTTON.db "Browse"; Tab; Enter on "Remove"
evidence.observed: After the accordion Enter, activeElement=BODY while aria-expanded=true. After Browse Enter, activeElement=BODY, and the next Tab went to SELECT[data-side=books] (top of the panel), not past the upload. After Remove Enter, activeElement=BODY.

findings.element: Run reconciliation when required uploads are missing, and the two "Browse" buttons
findings.finding: The error names no specific upload and focus stays on Run instead of moving to the missing drop zone, unlike the select errors; both upload buttons are named just "Browse".
findings.user_impact: A screen-reader user hears "Upload the required files (2 missing)" or "Upload the required file" with focus still on Run, then has to Tab through the page and guess which identical "Browse" belongs to which report.
findings.suggested_fix: Move focus to the first missing upload's Browse button, name each one after its file (for example aria-label "Browse for Stripe Payouts file"), and make the error say which files are missing.

evidence.action: Stripe + Stripe fees (both sides Manual), press Run with no files; separately, Stripe Assisted with one file, press Run
evidence.observed: role=alert read "Upload the required files (2 missing)" and then "Upload the required file"; in both cases activeElement=BUTTON#run "Run reconciliation". Both BUTTON.db have the accessible name "Browse" and no aria-label.

gaps: Focus-ring visibility on the native selects: computed styles show an unchanged 1px #DFE4EC border plus only a 3px rgba(0,83,204,0.12) ring on focus, which may be nearly invisible, but it was not checked at the pixel level.

Screen-reader announcement of the fade-in "How we get the data" section after an account is picked was not verified; no live region wraps it, so keyboard users may not know new controls appeared below.
Whether the "Reconciliation started" status (role=status) and the "Uploaded files cleared" notice (role=status) are actually spoken was checked from the DOM only, not with a real screen reader.
Focus position after Run starts and the form is disabled was not recorded; if Run itself is disabled, focus may drop to body.
